title: LADA Doofers vs Frost Giants, Oct 10
notes: Home game at Snoqualmie B: we wore white and had the left bench. YouTube had the video only at 1440p (scaled up for detection), as on Sep 19. Frost Giants' dark jerseys have a white shoulder yoke that passed our white-jersey test, so there were twice the usual review sheets; the reviewers dropped them and the referees.

The game sheet (SportNinja) gave the score, the scorers, the penalties, the shots and who played; each goal was found on the video and against the arena scoreboard, at 0:46, 3:11, 3:51, 35:15 and 59:51 of the video. A scramble at our net with 0:45 left in the 1st was waved off. The video runs to the final horn.

Periods from the board's clock: the 1st from the opening faceoff at 0:11 to 18:25 of video, the 2nd from 20:08 to 38:11, the 3rd from 39:50 to 63:29. The board counted a 1:00 intermission after the 1st and the 2nd. The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd and stopped at whistles in the 3rd.

Wheeler #0 in goal (his number wasn't readable on the video; white jersey, dark pads, as on Sep 19). Eleven skaters, two of them subs: Babkin #26 and Prozhogin #61. Absent: #1, #4, #11, #12, #13, #16, #20, #25, #27, #37, #44, #52, #54, #69, #76. The game sheet marks Joye #27 as playing, but no 27 appears on the video and the eleven fill the ice time.

Penalties: Prozhogin #61's hooking in the 2nd ran 3:00 on the board (2 minutes on the sheet); we played four from the whistle at 25:01 of video, and the box door opened 22 s after the penalty ran out (29:09). Polyanskiy #46's hooking in the 3rd, 2 minutes (46:07 to 48:55), killed off. Babkin #26's slashing came with 14 s left and he sat to the end. Frost Giants' Bentivenga #13 sat 2 minutes for tripping in the 3rd.
Shots on goal from the board, matching the game sheet: Doofers 27, Frost Giants 36.

Labeled by hand: on/off corrections from a frame-by-frame check of every lineup gap, mostly line changes made during stoppages. Zakharankau #97 was on for two 2nd-period stretches his tracks missed and for his goal. Albantov #29 left the ice at about 3:05 and came back right after the 2nd goal against; his change is set at 2:58 so the two shifts aren't joined across the goal.

Republished Oct 22, 2026 after a pipeline fix: a review row the reviewer called noise (an opponent or a referee, nobody of ours) now loses its OCR label instead of keeping it weakly. Ice time moved by #97 -42 s, #61 +14 s, #98 -14 s, #75 -10 s, #26 -9 s, #38 +6 s, #31 -4 s, #29 -4 s, #6 -2 s, #46 +2 s.

1st period, clock 14:57: a drive to our net, in during the scramble that follows, 0-2
1st period, clock 14:15: another scramble at our crease 40 s later, Kharoud #10 scores, 0-3
2nd period, clock 2:53: a shot from the slot and LaCroix #9 knocks in the rebound in the crease, 0-4
3rd period, clock 2:37: Zakharankau #97 scores from a scramble at their net with their goalie down, 1-4
2nd period, clock 12:22: hooking; the board ran 3:00, and the box door opened 22 s after it ran out
3rd period, clock 13:08: hooking, 2 minutes, killed off
3rd period, clock 0:14: slashing, 2 minutes; the game ended 46 s of video later with him in the box
